Scaffold the project exactly as the steering files describe (tech.md, structure.md, testing.md). There is no spec for this session: it is tooling only, and no feature code. Features come later, each from its own spec.

Deliver:

1. package.json (name "make-dinner", private, type module, engines node >=22 <23, MIT), .npmrc (save-exact=true), .nvmrc, with every script from tech.md. Install the dependencies the steering names, each pinned to an exact current version (look the versions up with `npm view <pkg> version`, do not guess): zod, hono, @hono/node-server, @anthropic-ai/sdk, preact, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk; dev: typescript, tsx, esbuild, vitest, fast-check, @playwright/test, @axe-core/playwright, eslint, typescript-eslint, eslint-plugin-import (or eslint-plugin-import-x if that is what works with flat config), @vitest/eslint-plugin, prettier, @types/node. Commit-ready package-lock.json. Do not run `npx playwright install` (Chromium is already installed on this machine).

2. TypeScript: a base tsconfig and one per package as tech.md says (core with lib ES2023 and types [], server, mcp, web with JSX for Preact and DOM lib, test). `npm run typecheck` must check all of them.

3. eslint.config.js (flat config) enforcing: the import boundaries in structure.md, the banned globals in src/core (Date, Math.random, performance, crypto, setTimeout, setInterval, process), no default exports, no disabled or focused tests, no-cycle. prettier config (.prettierrc.json: single quotes, semicolons, trailing commas, printWidth 100) and .prettierignore (ignore .kiro/, docs/kiro-evidence/, recordings/, public/assets/, dist/, package-lock.json).

4. vitest.config.ts so that `npm test` runs test/**/*.test.ts and `npm run test:props` runs test/**/*.pbt.ts. playwright.config.ts with a phone project (390x844) and a desktop project, a webServer that runs `npm run build && npm start` on a free port with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY unset, testDir e2e.

5. The smallest real code that lets every command run green, and nothing more:
   - src/core/result.ts (the Result type and ok/err helpers) and src/core/index.ts exporting it, with test/core/result.test.ts.
   - src/server/env.ts, errors.ts, app.ts (createApp(deps)), routes/health.ts (GET /api/health -> { status: "ok" }), index.ts; static serving of public/; the single onError handler; test/server/health.test.ts and a test that an unknown /api route returns 404 with { error: { code: "not_found" } }.
   - public/index.html shell and src/web/main.tsx rendering a placeholder heading "Make Dinner", src/web/styles/tokens.css with the tokens from ui.md (both themes), scripts/build-web.ts (esbuild, fails the build if "ANTHROPIC" or "sk-ant-" appears in public/assets/), scripts/check-contrast.ts implementing the rule in ui.md (parse tokens.css, both themes, fail on any pair below threshold) with a test for its contrast function.
   - e2e/smoke.spec.ts: the page loads, shows the heading, and has zero axe violations.
   - test/core/placeholder.pbt.ts is NOT wanted; instead make `npm run test:props` pass with zero property files only if vitest allows it cleanly (passWithNoTests for that script only). Do not write fake properties.

6. Dockerfile and render.yaml. Dockerfile: node:22-slim, WORKDIR /app, copy package*.json, `npm ci`, copy the rest, `npm run build`, ENV NODE_ENV=production PORT=3000, EXPOSE 3000, a HEALTHCHECK that fetches /api/health with node, CMD ["npm","start"]. Keep devDependencies installed (the build needs them; the free plan image size is fine). render.yaml: one free web service, runtime docker, healthCheckPath /api/health, envVars ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (sync: false), PARSE_RATE_PER_IP, PARSE_RATE_WINDOW_SEC, PARSE_DAILY_CAP, TRUST_PROXY=true. Add .dockerignore and .env.example. Do not run docker (it is switched off on this machine).

    export function ignore(filepath, context, skipExtensionCheck = false) {
        if (!skipExtensionCheck && !hasValidExtension(filepath, context)) {
            return true;
        }
        const ignoreStrings = context.settings['import-x/ignore'];
        if (!ignoreStrings?.length) {
            return false;
        }
        for (let i = 0, len = ignoreStrings.length; i < len; i++) {
            const ignoreString = ignoreStrings[i];
            const regex = new RegExp(ignoreString);
            if (regex.test(filepath)) {
                log(`ignoring ${filepath}, matched pattern /${ignoreString}/`);
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    export function hasValidExtension(filepath, context) {
        return validExtensions(context).has(path.extname(filepath));
    }
    //# sourceMappingURL=ignore.js.map
    exit 0

`import-x` only follows files with extensions listed in its `import-x/extensions` setting. The default is `.js/.mjs/.cjs`, so `.ts` files were silently skipped. I'll set it.

The e2e tests ran in a real Chromium (phone and desktop, light and dark). The server started on a free port with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` unset.

## Things you should know

1. **Playwright is pinned to 1.60.0, not 1.65.0.** 1.65.0 wants Chromium build 1254, and this machine has 1208, 1217 and 1223, so every e2e test failed to launch. 1.60.0 uses build 1223. I did not run `playwright install`. The pin is one line to change once browsers are updated.
2. **I added `playwright-core@1.60.0` as a dev dependency.** `@axe-core/playwright` pulled its own `playwright-core@1.65.0`, which caused a `Page` type mismatch in `npm run typecheck`. Pinning one copy dedupes it.
3. **TypeScript is 6.0.3, not 7.0.2.** `typescript-eslint` accepts only `<6.1.0`, and I did not use `--legacy-peer-deps`. I used `eslint-plugin-import-x` because `eslint-plugin-import` does not support ESLint 10. `@types/node` is 22.20.5 to match the Node 22 target.
4. **Node 22 was never exercised.** This machine runs Node 24.5, so every command ran on 24 with an engines warning. Node 22 is not installed. `npm ci --dry-run` accepts the lockfile, which I checked in a scratch directory.
5. **`package-lock.json` needed regenerating twice.** An incremental `npm install` drops `rolldown`'s platform bindings from the lockfile (an npm bug). The committed lockfile has all 15, including Linux, which Docker's `npm ci` needs. If you add a dependency later, run `rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install`.
6. **`npm audit` reports 9 moderate issues.** They are a `minimatch` denial-of-service in the ESLint toolchain (dev only). The only offered fix downgrades ESLint.

## Departures from what you listed

- **`scripts/kiro-render.mjs` was reformatted.** `prettier --check .` failed on it. The change is line wrapping only (9 lines added, 3 removed). It also causes the one lint warning, an unused `eslint-disable` directive that I left in place.
- **`src/mcp/index.ts` is a placeholder (`export {}`).** `tsconfig.mcp.json` fails with no input file.
- **`tsconfig.tools.json` is a sixth tsconfig.** It type-checks `scripts/` and the two config files.
- **`src/server/log.ts` is an extra file.** `tech.md` requires `LOG_LEVEL` and redaction of key/token/secret/authorization fields, and `onError` needs a logger.
- **`npm run record` points at `scripts/record.ts`, which does not exist yet.** It will fail until that script is written.
- **Default exports are allowed in three tool configs.** These are `eslint.config.js`, `vitest.config.ts` and `playwright.config.ts`, because the tools require them.
- **Playwright's `webServer.command` uses `unset ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.** The key is unset rather than empty.

## How I checked the checks

- **Red first.** I wrote each test against a stub that behaves wrongly. They failed on assertions (4 for `result`, 39 for the server, 18 for the scripts) before I wrote the real code.
- **Lint rules fire.** I wrote throwaway violation files and confirmed every import boundary, banned global, default export, and skipped or focused test is rejected.
- **`import-x/no-cycle` first checked nothing.** It silently skipped `.ts` files until I set `import-x/extensions`. It now reports a real cycle, and the throwaway files are deleted.
- **The build guard fails on a marker.** With `ANTHROPIC` temporarily in the bundle, the build exited 1. With it removed, exit 0.

- **Docker, Render, `npm run record`, MCP and Node 22.** None of these were run or verified.
